title: OpenRCT2 v0.5.1 "Swamp Castle" released Last version to support Windows 7
summary: OpenRCT2 v0.5.1 "Swamp Castle" is released as the final version to support Windows 7, continuing the open-source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 with bug fixes and modern compatibility improvements.
problem_solved: Keeps the classic RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 game alive with modern features while dropping legacy Windows 7 support.
why_valuable: Provides free access to a beloved classic game with ongoing development and community-driven enhancements.
